events.title: Creation
events.summary: God creates the heavens and the earth, and humanity in his image.

events.title: The Fall
events.summary: Adam and Eve disobey, and sin and death enter the world.

events.title: Cain and Abel
events.summary: The first murder, and the first family line outside Eden.

events.title: The Flood
events.summary: Noah builds the ark; God makes a covenant with creation afterward.

events.title: Tower of Babel
events.summary: Languages are confused and the nations scatter.

events.title: Call of Abraham
events.note: Dating the patriarchs is debated; estimates range across roughly 2100–1800 BC.
events.summary: God calls Abram out of Haran with the promise of land, a nation, and blessing.

events.title: The covenant with Abraham
events.summary: God confirms the promise and gives the sign of circumcision.

events.title: Isaac is born
events.summary: The promised son arrives, and Abraham is tested on Mount Moriah.

events.title: Jacob becomes Israel
events.summary: Jacob's dream at Bethel, and his wrestling at the Jabbok.

events.title: Joseph in Egypt
events.note: Date debated; depends on how the 430 years in Egypt is counted.
events.summary: Sold by his brothers, Joseph rises to rule Egypt and saves his family from famine.

events.title: Moses is born
events.note: Assumes the early date of the Exodus (about 1446 BC).
events.summary: Hidden from Pharaoh's decree, Moses is raised in the royal household.

events.title: The burning bush
events.summary: God calls Moses at Horeb to bring Israel out of Egypt.

events.title: The plagues and Passover
events.note: Early date (1 Kings 6:1). A late date of about 1260 BC is also argued.
events.summary: Ten plagues on Egypt, and the first Passover.

events.title: Crossing the Red Sea
events.summary: Israel passes through the sea; Pharaoh's army is lost.

events.title: The law at Sinai
events.summary: The Ten Commandments and the covenant at Mount Sinai.

events.title: The tabernacle
events.summary: Instructions for and construction of the tent of meeting.

events.title: Forty years in the wilderness
events.summary: Israel refuses to enter the land at Kadesh and wanders a generation.

events.title: Death of Moses
events.summary: Moses sees the land from Mount Nebo; Joshua succeeds him.

events.title: Crossing the Jordan and Jericho
events.summary: Israel enters Canaan; the walls of Jericho fall.

events.title: Joshua's farewell
events.summary: "Choose you this day whom ye will serve."

events.title: The period of the judges
events.summary: A repeating cycle of sin, oppression, cry for help, and deliverance.

events.title: Gideon
events.summary: Three hundred men defeat Midian.

events.title: Ruth and Boaz
events.summary: A Moabite widow finds a kinsman-redeemer in Bethlehem.

events.title: Samuel is called
events.summary: Hannah's son hears God's voice in the night at Shiloh.

events.title: Samson
events.summary: A Nazirite judge who fights the Philistines.

events.title: Saul is anointed king
events.summary: Israel asks for a king and Samuel anoints Saul.

events.title: David and Goliath
events.summary: David is anointed and defeats the Philistine champion.

events.title: David becomes king
events.summary: King in Hebron, then Jerusalem becomes his capital.

events.title: The Davidic covenant
events.summary: God promises David a house and a throne that will endure.

events.title: Solomon reigns
events.summary: Solomon asks for wisdom and receives it.

events.title: The temple is built
events.summary: The first temple is built in Jerusalem and dedicated.

events.title: The kingdom divides
events.summary: Rehoboam's harshness splits Israel and Judah.

events.title: Elijah on Mount Carmel
events.summary: The prophet confronts the prophets of Baal in Ahab's reign.

events.title: Elisha's ministry
events.summary: Elisha succeeds Elijah and works wonders in Israel.

events.title: Jonah sent to Nineveh
events.summary: A reluctant prophet and a city that repents.

events.title: Amos and Hosea prophesy
events.summary: Warnings of judgment on the northern kingdom.

events.title: Isaiah's call
events.summary: "In the year that king Uzziah died" Isaiah sees the Lord.

events.title: Fall of Samaria
events.summary: Assyria ends the northern kingdom and deports its people.

events.title: Hezekiah and Sennacherib
events.summary: Jerusalem is besieged and delivered.

events.title: Jeremiah's call
events.summary: Jeremiah begins a ministry that will last through Jerusalem's fall.

events.title: Josiah's reforms
events.summary: The Book of the Law is found in the temple and revival follows.

events.title: Daniel taken to Babylon
events.summary: Nebuchadnezzar's first deportation includes Daniel and his friends.

events.title: Ezekiel's vision
events.summary: Ezekiel sees the glory of God by the River Chebar.

events.title: Jerusalem and the temple destroyed
events.summary: Babylon burns the city; Judah goes into exile.

events.title: Daniel in the lions' den
events.summary: Under Darius the Mede, Daniel is delivered.

events.title: Cyrus lets the exiles return
events.summary: The Persian king decrees that the temple be rebuilt.

events.title: The second temple is finished
events.summary: Encouraged by Haggai and Zechariah, the people finish the work.

events.title: Esther becomes queen
events.summary: A Jewish queen of Persia, and a people saved.

events.title: Ezra returns
events.summary: Ezra teaches the law to the returned community.

events.title: Nehemiah rebuilds the wall
events.summary: The walls of Jerusalem are rebuilt in fifty-two days.

events.title: Malachi
events.summary: The last Old Testament prophet points ahead to the messenger of the covenant.

events.title: Alexander conquers Persia
events.summary: The Greek empire arrives, as Daniel's vision describes the he-goat.

events.title: The Maccabean revolt
events.summary: Antiochus Epiphanes desecrates the temple; Jewish resistance restores it.

events.title: Rome takes Jerusalem
events.summary: Pompey brings Judea under Roman control.

events.title: The birth of Jesus
events.note: Most scholars place it between 6 and 4 BC, before Herod's death.
events.summary: Born in Bethlehem; the magi and the flight to Egypt.

events.title: Baptism and temptation
events.summary: Jesus is baptized by John and tempted in the wilderness.

events.title: Sermon on the Mount
events.summary: The Beatitudes and Jesus' teaching on the kingdom.

events.title: The triumphal entry
events.note: The year of the crucifixion is debated: AD 30 and AD 33 are the main options.
events.summary: Jesus enters Jerusalem the week before his death.

events.title: The Last Supper and crucifixion
events.summary: Jesus is betrayed, tried and crucified at Passover.

events.title: The resurrection
events.summary: The empty tomb and the appearances to the disciples.

events.title: The ascension
events.summary: Forty days after the resurrection Jesus is taken up.

events.title: Pentecost
events.summary: The Spirit is given and the church begins in Jerusalem.

events.title: Stephen is martyred
events.summary: The first Christian martyr; the church scatters.

events.title: Paul's conversion
events.summary: Saul meets the risen Christ on the road to Damascus.

events.title: Cornelius and the Gentiles
events.summary: Peter preaches to a Roman household and the Spirit falls on them.

events.title: Paul's first journey
events.summary: Barnabas and Paul plant churches in Cyprus and Galatia.

events.title: The Jerusalem Council
events.summary: The church decides Gentiles need not keep the law of Moses to be saved.

events.title: Paul's second journey
events.summary: Macedonia, Athens and Corinth; the Thessalonian letters follow.

events.title: Paul's third journey
events.summary: Ephesus is the base; Corinthians and Romans are written.

events.title: Paul in Rome
events.summary: Shipwrecked on Malta, Paul reaches Rome and writes from custody.

events.title: Jerusalem destroyed
events.summary: Rome destroys the temple, as Jesus foretold.

events.title: John receives Revelation
events.summary: The apostle John, exiled on Patmos, records his visions.
